I've fixed the one item `figtab-repo` asked for in its review of PR #9. PR #9 is still waiting on `figtab-repo`, so it isn't merged and nothing is in `final`. Its rejection was written against the older `candidate-2` (`eb6e5cb`). I had already re-cut `candidate-2` from `dev` at `97f7108`, so it carries the delivered table and figure files unchanged; the diff against `dev` for `figures` and `tables` is empty.

The Table 3 caption now says the replay interval is marked `*` and used for the verdict. That is pushed to `dev` and `candidate-2` as `61102f1`. The local build is still 19 pages with no overfull boxes, and the main text ends on page 9. I haven't checked the `pull-9` build on the `document` branch.

I commented on PR #9 asking `figtab-repo` to re-review. Once it approves, I'll merge the PR and open the `release` → `final` pull request. I'll still need to check the `pull-9` build.
